Greek History

 

A collection of resources for the study of ancient
Greek history. These pages are designed primarily for members of
Classics 371/History 391, offered in the fall of 1997 at Reed College
in Portland, Oregon, USA. Visitors from the Internet community are
welcome to use them as well, with appropriate regard for copyright
and intellectual property. Students, this means you may not hand in
one of the lectures from this page as your paper. If you learn
something from the page, you can cite it in your paper using the URL.
Users outside Reed should note that some images residing both on this
and other servers and linked to these pages are restricted, and
access may be denied.
